name: port-allowlist

scripts.docs:dev: node scripts/prepare-docs.mjs && npm run dev --prefix docs-site
scripts.docs:build: node scripts/prepare-docs.mjs && npm run build --prefix docs-site
scripts.build:site: npm run docs:build && npm run build:demo && node scripts/assemble-site.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write "web/**/*.{ts,tsx,css}" "shared/**/*.ts" "docs-site/**/*.{md,mdx,mjs,ts,css,json}" "scripts/{assemble-site,check-content,prepare-docs,serve-site}.mjs" "tests/{browser,site,i18n,store,errors,timezone,configuration,expiry,setup}.mjs" src/expiry.ts src/portal.ts src/script-locale.ts README.md README.zh-CN.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "web/**/*.{ts,tsx,css}" "shared/**/*.ts" "docs-site/**/*.{md,mdx,mjs,ts,css,json}" "scripts/{assemble-site,check-content,prepare-docs,serve-site}.mjs" "tests/{browser,site,i18n,store,errors,timezone,configuration,expiry,setup}.mjs" src/expiry.ts src/portal.ts src/script-locale.ts README.md README.zh-CN.md

description: Self-service, single-port IP allowlists with Cloudflare and an ECS-local Alibaba Cloud synchronizer
